text:
sam-sales: Quick sync — Reseller Embedder wants a 2-week pilot where they embed our SDK into their hosted control panel. They asked about entitlements, per-seat billing, and an architecture diagram we can share. cc @maya-se for tech, @sarah-legal for entitlements/contract gaps.

maya-se: Got it. Do we have a recommended lightweight architecture for an embedded widget that calls Redwood Hosted API (multi-tenant) vs Dedicated for mid-market? I'm thinking guidance around token scoping and CORS.

sam-sales: They prefer hosted for speed but want isolation options later. Pricing question: can we do a blended price for initial pilot (metered usage cap + flat engineering hours)? They asked for a firm number to present to procurement tomorrow.

anjali-partner: Hi all — from reseller side: pilot target is 5 customers, <100 MAU each, mostly short chat completions and embeddings for search. They need an NDA-ready SOW and quick security questionnaire answers today. Can we provide SOC2 scope and encryption details?

maya-se: For architecture: two options: 1) Hosted API with per-tenant API keys and client-side widget that proxies through partner backend (recommended for entitlements + rate-limit isolation). 2) Dedicated per-partner pool (if they want strict token separation). I'll sketch a diagram and sample config.

maya-se: Sample config snippet they can drop into partner backend (proxy pattern):
```
POST /partner/api/generate -> validate partner session -> add X-Partner-ID header -> call https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate with partner-api-key (scoped)
```

tom-fe: For the widget, prefer partner-backend proxy. Avoid embedding our API key in frontend. CORS rules: partner backend must allow origin from partner domain. We can provide a tiny example repo for them.

sam-sales: Pricing — can we offer pilot price: $2k flat + $0.0008/token up to 5M tokens? If they exceed cap, go to standard per-token. Also include 8 hours of engineering at $200/hr. Need a yes/no now.

maya-se: Engineering hours and a usage cap is fine for pilot. I want product to sign off on $0.0008/token — sounds reasonable for chat + embeddings at pilot scale. @sarah-legal can draft a short SOW that references usage cap and overage terms.

sarah-legal: I can draft SOW. Need to flag two items: reseller wants to resell (not just integrate) — we need reseller addendum and clarity on data handling. Also need to confirm KYC for their customers if they want invoice pass-through. I'll add a clause limiting liability and a simple termination for convenience during pilot.

anjali-partner: Reseller confirms they will not store raw audio or PII in the demo. They do want to know about customer data retention windows and whether we support customer-managed keys later.

sec-bot: Security checklist: SOC2 Type II (link: https://redwood.company/security/soc2), data encryption in transit (TLS1.2+), at-rest AES-256, optional Bring-Your-Own-Key via KMS for Private deployments.

maya-se: For pilot, recommend Hosted with partner proxy, token scoping (partner-api-key) and short-lived session tokens for end-users. If they want BYOK or HSM, that pushes to Private or Dedicated later.

tom-fe: I'll spin up the example widget repo and share a deployable staging demo by EOD. Small note: we should include health checks and a simple retry/backoff snippet for 429s.

maya-se: Ops question: how do we want routing to work if their partner backend misbehaves? Canary to fallback model? I suggest a fail-open to a lower-cost model variant to avoid total outage during pilot.

sam-sales: Good point. For pilot SLA we'll promise best-effort, but add a fallback policy: if primary model hits 95th pct latency > 2s for 5m, route to cheaper variant. Ops can document in runbook.

anjali-partner: Procurement asked for latency SLOs and a contact for onboarding support during pilot window. Can we commit a named SE and 2 weekly office hours?

maya-se: I can be the named SE for onboarding. Weekly office hours ok. I'll include a short onboarding checklist and sample prompts they've asked to test (search re-ranking + FAQ answering).

sarah-legal: Draft SOW + reseller addendum ETA: tomorrow morning. Will include pilot term, fees, overage, data handling, and a stop-gap NDA paragraph.

sam-sales: Thanks. Next steps: @maya-se share architecture diagram + repo link, @tom-fe demo widget link, @sarah-legal SOW and addendum, @sec-bot or sec team confirm any additional answers to their security questionnaire. I'll send pricing proposal to reseller now with pilot numbers.

anjali-partner: Great — sharing internal decision timeline: procurement meets in 48 hours. If we get the SOW + security answers + demo link before then, we're likely to proceed. :thumbsup:

maya-se: Uploading diagram to partner drive and pushing example repo to github now. Will post links shortly.

sec-bot: Reminder: if they request a security questionnaire PDF, route to security@redwood.ai with subject "Reseller Embedder Pilot - Questionnaire".

sam-sales: Awesome — keeping this thread as the single source. Ping here once links are posted and I'll loop in executive sponsor for faster signoff.

anjali-partner: Thanks everyone.
